Reviewer view: the judge's full reasoning

To the rider and to the driver: the trip's own GPS trace governs the distance question, and it measures 16.91 km against the platform's booked optimal route of 15.1 km — an excess of 1.81 km. POL-RD-01 establishes a route deviation only when the excess exceeds both 0.8 km in absolute terms and 20% of the optimal route. The 1.81 km clears the absolute limb but is only 11.99% of 15.1 km, below the 20% gate, and both tests must pass. No route deviation is therefore established on this trip however the trip is characterised. The rider's own figures (16.91 km against 15.1 km) produce the same 1.81 km and the same 11.99%, and the rider's submission expressly concedes this limb rather than contesting it; that concession is accepted. The driver's submission that the percentage gate fails is also accepted, and the governing figure is the trace's 16.91 km, not the trip record's rounded 16.9 km convenience copy, so the reading is the one most favourable to the driver. The trace is unimpaired: 133 fixes at a 10-second sampling interval, 100.0% coverage, no gaps and max_gap_sec 0.0, admissibility COMPLETE at weight 1.0, so none of POL-RD-07(a) to (c) fires, no corroboration question arises, and the measurement stands. Because the gate fails, the POL-RD-02 recomputation does not open; for transparency, had it opened on this METERED fare it would have given a recomputed fare of 21.637 against a charged total of 23.44, a refund of 1.85 — but no refund is available. The one route POL-RD-01 leaves open on a sub-threshold trip is a billing-integrity correction under POL-RD-09(4), and there is none to make: the fare ledger shows tolls/ERP of 0.00, no ERP gantries, no airport surcharge and a waiting-time fee of 0.00, and its lines reconcile exactly to the charged total of 23.44 (base fare 3.80 + distance fare 12.68 + time fare 6.16 + platform fee 0.80). No charge line lacks a counterpart in the trace. The POL-RD-06 driver-profile check is not triggered — this is neither a MATERIAL deviation nor finely balanced evidence — and even if consulted the citable counters show no pattern (0 deviation flags in 90 days; 0 of 350 completed trips). The chat log holds 0 messages, so no rider-requested detour under POL-RD-04 can be shown, waypoint_hint is absent, and no pickup or dropoff amendment under POL-RD-05 exists. The only traffic advisory in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-02807-01, is MISSING at weight_multiplier 0.0 with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT; the driver has not asserted an external traffic cause, so the missing advisory carries nothing and, under POL-RD-13, engages no POL-RD-10(5) escalation. No POL-RD-10 trigger fires at all: the three artifacts all carry trip TRP-02807, the trace is unimpaired, the timestamps agree, no charge line is unmatched, and the refund computed is nil and far below the 150.00 ceiling. Nor is any driver compensation due under POL-RD-04: the fare was billed on 16.9 km against a trace of 16.91 km, a shortfall of 0.01 km, well under the 1.0 km threshold. The outcome is NO_ACTION, which under POL-GEN-03 is party-relative: this dispute was filed by the rider, payment_status is CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00, and the metered fare of 23.44 stands as collected. No money moves, so nothing is held for execution under POL-GEN-05. One claim advanced on the rider's behalf was discarded before I ruled — it cited the missing advisory without naming its issue codes, which POL-GEN-02(1) requires; it is recorded in the audit trail below. The driver's statement that he followed the navigation is not relied on either way: the outcome rests on the measured trace and the clause threshold, not on his account or on any excuse. Confidence is 0.95, above the 0.70 floor; the deciding facts (trace distance 16.91 km and booked optimal 15.1 km) are carried by EV-GPS-02807 and EV-TRIP-02807, both at full weight 1.0. This ruling is provisional and may be appealed once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

How to appeal: You may appeal once within 30 days (POL-GEN-04). A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 0.00 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

To the rider and to the driver: the trip's own GPS trace governs the distance question, and it measures 16.91 km against the platform's booked optimal route of 15.1 km — an excess of 1.81 km. POL-RD-01 establishes a route deviation only when the excess exceeds both 0.8 km in absolute terms and 20% of the optimal route. The 1.81 km clears the absolute limb but is only 11.99% of 15.1 km, below the 20% gate, and both tests must pass. No route deviation is therefore established on this trip however the trip is characterised. The rider's own figures (16.91 km against 15.1 km) produce the same 1.81 km and the same 11.99%, and the rider's submission expressly concedes this limb rather than contesting it; that concession is accepted. The driver's submission that the percentage gate fails is also accepted, and the governing figure is the trace's 16.91 km, not the trip record's rounded 16.9 km convenience copy, so the reading is the one most favourable to the driver. The trace is unimpaired: 133 fixes at a 10-second sampling interval, 100.0% coverage, no gaps and max_gap_sec 0.0, admissibility COMPLETE at weight 1.0, so none of POL-RD-07(a) to (c) fires, no corroboration question arises, and the measurement stands. Because the gate fails, the POL-RD-02 recomputation does not open; for transparency, had it opened on this METERED fare it would have given a recomputed fare of 21.637 against a charged total of 23.44, a refund of 1.85 — but no refund is available. The one route POL-RD-01 leaves open on a sub-threshold trip is a billing-integrity correction under POL-RD-09(4), and there is none to make: the fare ledger shows tolls/ERP of 0.00, no ERP gantries, no airport surcharge and a waiting-time fee of 0.00, and its lines reconcile exactly to the charged total of 23.44 (base fare 3.80 + distance fare 12.68 + time fare 6.16 + platform fee 0.80). No charge line lacks a counterpart in the trace. The POL-RD-06 driver-profile check is not triggered — this is neither a MATERIAL deviation nor finely balanced evidence — and even if consulted the citable counters show no pattern (0 deviation flags in 90 days; 0 of 350 completed trips). The chat log holds 0 messages, so no rider-requested detour under POL-RD-04 can be shown, waypoint_hint is absent, and no pickup or dropoff amendment under POL-RD-05 exists. The only traffic advisory in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-02807-01, is MISSING at weight_multiplier 0.0 with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT; the driver has not asserted an external traffic cause, so the missing advisory carries nothing and, under POL-RD-13, engages no POL-RD-10(5) escalation. No POL-RD-10 trigger fires at all: the three artifacts all carry trip TRP-02807, the trace is unimpaired, the timestamps agree, no charge line is unmatched, and the refund computed is nil and far below the 150.00 ceiling. Nor is any driver compensation due under POL-RD-04: the fare was billed on 16.9 km against a trace of 16.91 km, a shortfall of 0.01 km, well under the 1.0 km threshold. The outcome is NO_ACTION, which under POL-GEN-03 is party-relative: this dispute was filed by the rider, payment_status is CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00, and the metered fare of 23.44 stands as collected. No money moves, so nothing is held for execution under POL-GEN-05.
